title: Qt: InterfaceListManager: watch preferences only after start
description:
Move the "select the default interface if no interfaces are selected"
into the InterfaceListManager instead of main. It makes sense to select the
default interface if all previously selected interfaces went away, or if
loading the interfaces for the first time at startup, and also removes some
duplication in Stratoshark and Wireshark.

Setting the warning message still works when the interfaces are never
initially scanned.

Also, only start requesting a refresh if the preferences are changed
once we know the initial preference value, avoiding requesting extra
refreshes at the start.

Also for a few of the now file-static functions that only refer to
the global interface options, since they're file-static and in a C++
file, pass by-reference.

Ping #21318

notes.body: Making it asynchronous works fine, but it's kind of pointless as written because putting it on the event loop just means that it is executed at the next `splash_update`, which then will have the next splash message instead of the one for the interfaces. So I will split out the other improvements.

commits_data.title: Qt: InterfaceListManager: watch preferences after start
commits_data.message:
Qt: InterfaceListManager: watch preferences after start

Move the "select the default interface if no interfaces are selected"
into the InterfaceListManager instead of main. This means we can safely
make the initial discovery asynchronous (but it doesn't make sense to
do so when it would still happen at the next splash_update). It makes
sense to select the default interface if all previously selected interfaces
went away, or if interfaces are being loaded for the first time in the
program because they weren't loaded at start, and also removes some
duplication in Stratoshark and Wireshark.

Setting the warning message still works when the interfaces are never
initially scanned.

Also, only start requesting a refresh if the preferences are changed
once we know the initial preference value, avoiding requesting extra
refreshes at the start.

Also for a few of the now file-static functions that only refer to
the global interface options, since they're file-static and in a C++
file, pass by-reference.

Ping #21318
